          File names

          Example: 251018_Project_Final.mp4  ·  cuts and stills get a number: 251018_Project_Social_01.mp4. Each deliverable's label is set below.

          Deliverables

          Formats and codecs are read from your Resolve, and every file is rendered by Resolve's own engine. To carry over advanced Deliver settings, start a deliverable from one of your Deliver presets.

            Your changes are saved as small JSON files in . "Reset" brings a built-in deliverable back to its defaults.
